Relationship
0:05
Let's study the word relationship.
0:09
Definition: the way in which two people, groups or countries behave towards each other or deal with each other.
0:17
Example: Maintaining a strong relationship with your relatives becomes crucial later in adulthood.
0:24
Collocations
0:26
First collocation: establish a relationship.
0:30
Second collocation: close relationship.
0:34
Third collocation: personal relationship.
0:38
Fourth collocation: working relationship.
